gold_sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-91.491978 46.302048)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-91.491978 46.302048)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'living_street'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-91.491978 46.302048)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH resort_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-91.491978, 46.302048), 4326)::geography AS resort_point
),
living_streets AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry,
    ST_Distance(resort_point, geometry) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    roads,
    resort_geom
  WHERE 
    highway = 'living_street' AND
    ST_DWithin(resort_point, geometry, 10000) -- Limit search to 10 km for performance
),
closest_road AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry,
    distance_meters
  FROM 
    living_streets
  ORDER BY 
    distance_meters
  LIMIT 1
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(
      ST_Slope(
        ST_Clip(
          r.rast, 
          (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM closest_road)
        ),
        1
      )
    ) AS slope_dump
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    closest_road
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM closest_road))
),
slope_values AS (
  SELECT 
    (slope_dump).val AS slope_deg
  FROM 
    slope_analysis
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT distance_meters FROM closest_road) AS distance_meters,
  ROUND(AVG(slope_deg)::numeric, 2) AS mean_slope_deg,
  'Traut''s Resort LLC' AS resort_name,
  'living_street' AS road_type
FROM 
  slope_values;
